latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — turn photos into LinkedIn-ready videos.

- Converts JPG, PNG, HEIC, and WebP images up to 200MB into 1080p MP4 videos for LinkedIn.
- Fast cloud processing (30–60 seconds per export).
- Supports text overlays, background music, and aspect ratio adjustments.
- Handles uploads, exports, credits, and state tracking via simple commands.
- Includes robust error handling with guided user feedback.
